subject: Mutual action plan & acceptance lab: test vectors, exit gates, and timeline
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@nikhonhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP request: acceptance tests, evidence needs, timeline

Hi Stephanie and Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency profile and the routing fallbacks. Procurement asked me to capture a tight mutual action plan so we can move decisions to the legal / procurement teams next week.

High-level asks from Nikhon:
- Clear success criteria for the pilot (functional + perf).
- A short list of acceptance tests we can run against our sample workload (medical notes ingestion + query).
- Exit gates (what will cause us to stop or request remediation).
- Timeline for evidence delivery (logs, SOC2 artifacts, perf run results).

I attached a short spreadsheet with our initial sample payloads (attached: acceptance-test-vectors.csv) and a procurement checklist. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
1) p95 text generation latency < 250ms for 128-token requests under pilot load (30 rps burst to 80 rps),
2) prefix/KV caching enabled for repeated prompts,
3) audit log of requests with token counts and model version for a 60-day retention window.

Target: pilot decision by 2026-12-08. If we can align on the MAP and test plan by EOD Friday (2026-11-27) I will schedule legal + procurement for the 12/01 slot.

Thanks — Emily

Emily Park
Director, Digital Platforms
Nikhon Health

Attachments: acceptance-test-vectors.csv (CSV, 124KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@nikhonhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request: acceptance tests, evidence needs, timeline

Hi Emily — great to hear the demo landed well.

We can absolutely support the items you listed. High-level proposed acceptance approach (summary):

1) Acceptance test suite (we'll deliver as a runnable set + result report)
   - Functional checks: prompt fidelity, deterministic tool calling for structured outputs (JSON schema compliance).
   - Perf checks: p50/p95/p99 latency under three load profiles (30 rps steady, 80 rps burst, 10 rps background).
   - Quality checks: end-to-end accuracy on 200 labeled samples from your CSV (we will run and produce confusion matrix + qualitative vignettes).

2) Exit gates (stop/hold conditions)
   - Hard stop: p95 latency > 500ms sustained for 10 minutes during burst profile OR > 30% task failure rate on labeled samples.
   - Hold & mitigate: p95 latency between 250–500ms for more than one stress window OR repeatable YAML/JSON schema mismatches.

3) Evidence & artifacts we will provide
   - Perf run artifacts: raw traces, token-level latency histogram, model variant used, kernel config.
   - Security artifacts: SOC 2 summary, audit-log sample (redacted), KMS configuration details for Private deployments.
   - Test report: pass/fail matrix, edge-case vignettes, suggested mitigations.

4) Timeline proposal
   - 11/24 (today): confirm MAP scope and test vectors.
   - 11/25–11/27: Redwood runs baseline tests on your CSV (we'll use staging data + your sample).
   - 11/30: deliver test report and artifacts.
   - 12/01: joint review with procurement/legal.
   - 12/08: target decision.

I've attached a MAP outline (MAP-v1.xlsx) with owners and the test roster. Camila will own the perf runs and Ben will coordinate procurement checklist / credits.

Is there any regulatory artifact beyond SOC 2 we should include for the test report (e.g., contract language about retention windows)?

–Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily@nikhonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request: acceptance tests, evidence needs, timeline

Emily — looping in the perf plan and the concrete acceptance test vectors. Quick notes from the engineering side:

- Test harness: we'll run three 20-minute runs for each profile (steady, burst, background) using your CSV. Each run will emit token-level traces and per-request headers.
- Caching: we'll enable prefix/KV caching on the staging model variant; we will report cache hit rate and show delta in cost/latency.
- Model variant: we'll test against the 13B quantized variant (q4_2) and a float16 fallback for worst-case latency comparison.

Concrete acceptance thresholds for the pilot (proposal):
- p50 < 90ms (128 tokens), p95 < 250ms (128 tokens) for steady;
- Burst p95 < 400ms for <5 minute sustained bursts;
- End-to-end JSON schema compliance >= 98% on labeled set;
- Cache hit rate >= 20% for repeated prompts in your dataset.

I'll attach the raw test vectors we used (acceptance-test-vectors.csv) and a minimal runbook for reproducing the checks. Expect first run artifacts on 11/25 afternoon PST.

Camila Reyes
Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acceptance-test-vectors.csv (CSV, 124KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@nikhonhealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request: acceptance tests, evidence needs, timeline

Emily — quick procurement note.

We can commit to the timeline above and provide the artifacts listed. A couple of items for your procurement team to scope ahead of the 12/01 call:
- Temporary trial credits + account sandbox for the pilot (we'll provision a dedicated pool).
- Standard commercial terms: we'll share a one-page MOA (term summary) before the call and can run DocuSign on 12/02 if all parties are aligned.
- Audit retention: we can provide a 60-day sample of audit logs for the pilot. For longer retention or special KMS/HSM requirements we'll need to move to a Private deployment addendum.

Laura — can you prepare the MOA one-pager and a procurement checklist?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — this looks good and aligned with our expectations. Procurement confirmed the 12/01 review slot is booked; legal would like the MOA one-pager by 11/30 COB.

We have one small tweak to exit gates: can we make the hard stop condition p95 > 450ms sustained for 10 minutes (instead of 500ms)? Our engineering team is comfortable with that buffer if the mitigation path (fallback to smaller model variant) is automated and documented in the runbook.

If you can update the MAP-v1.xlsx with that exit gate and upload the MOA draft to the Drive link below, we are set to review on 12/01. I'll circulate the procurement PO template in the Drive as well.

I will upload the signed intent (scoped MOA) after the 12/01 meeting if all good — will aim to have signatures by 12/08.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Emily Park
Director, Digital Platforms
Nikhon Health
